Welcome to Our Channel ASMR MASSAGE Therapy - Here you will find videos of people getting,shaves, hair cut and massage.this channel is all about Indian art of barbering.every barber has his own technique of performing shave,hair cut,and massage and every experience is different from other.

So watch,comments, share and subscribe.
Please support me for watching Daily Asmr videos from all over India.

Every comments or Questions will be highly appreciated 

THANK YOU
